title: Evaluating outputs: metrics, checks and their limits
hook: What PSNR, SSIM and FID compare, what each misses, and how to test them on a pair where a score means something.

verified.claim: A search of comfy and comfy_extras finds no PSNR, SSIM or LPIPS code.
verified.ref: grep over comfy and comfy_extras at v0.43.0

verified.claim: Every table comes from the lab.
FID is named in the Heusel et al. abstract, and the LPIPS paper calls PSNR and SSIM shallow.

unchecked: The FID formula and SSIM's constants are written from common knowledge. We read the abstracts, not the formulas in the papers.
Our grep can't cover third-party packs: some may offer metric nodes.
We did not run a real FID or LPIPS.
